mechanism: Both fluoxetine and berberine inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes, potentially increasing fluoxetine levels and serotonergic effects; berberine may also have mild serotonergic activity.
action: Monitor for increased serotonergic side effects (agitation, tremor, hyperreflexia); consider dose adjustment or spacing administration; counsel on serotonin syndrome symptoms.
